populationContract.nucleusGate: matched centroid assignment; CellViT neoplastic; non-edge; type probability >=0.70; finite area/compactness/solidity/eccentricity; area 5–250 µm²; compactness >=0.15; solidity >=0.50; equivalent diameter <=20 µm

supportThreshold.application: Required in every mouse for full within-cluster inference; included contexts outside the fully supported subset (C0/C1) remain descriptive.

occurrence.definition: at least one frozen tile assigned to the run-local phenotype

treatmentContrast.reason: The phenotype has zero tiles in both Vehicle mice; residual-nucleus morphology exists only in PLX mice and cannot define a matched within-context Vehicle-versus-PLX contrast.

claimMatrix.plainLanguageFinding: C3 was absent from both Vehicle mice and present in both PLX4720 mice; its provisional image interpretation is Necrosis-enriched injury-like tumour tissue with focal haemorrhage and residual viable, inflammatory or stromal components; a candidate treatment-emergent response phenotype.
claimMatrix.caution: The clustering was arm-blinded, but the biological interpretation was amended after treatment mapping was known. With two mice per arm this does not establish causal drug-induced necrosis or therapeutic efficacy; pathologist and orthogonal validation are required.

limitations: Only 4 mice are available, with two mice and one WSI per treatment arm.
The C0–C1 treatment restriction is post-hoc and exploratory; it must be confirmed in an independently specified and replicated analysis.
Mouse is the experimental unit; nuclei and tiles are never treatment replicates.
Exact two-sided randomization p-values have a minimum attainable value of 2/6=1/3.
Restricted cluster fractions are compositional and cannot be interpreted independently.
Observed-mixture effects combine context proportions and within-context morphology.
Treatment-emergent phenotype fractions use explicit mouse-level zeros; their provisional biological meaning was amended after treatment mapping was known and remains pending pathologist review.
Residual detected nuclei in injury/necrosis-like tissue are descriptive and require segmentation-label QC before viable-tumour interpretation.
The Kitagawa/Oaxaca decomposition and observed-minus-standardized contrast are descriptive, non-causal algebra.
Classifiers use tiles from the same H&E sections used to define clusters and are not independent pathology validation.
All cluster identities remain provisional pending pathologist review.
